caption:
my sister took every lecture about the front door lock in nineteen ninety-eight.
by the time i turned sixteen, nobody even looked up from the television.
send this to the one who still reminds you how strict mum used to be.

#siblings #oldersiblings #growingupwithsiblings
alt: a one-slide post showing a small green donkey giving a knowing look beside text about getting midnight curfew for free because an older sibling took the shouting years earlier.
